scenario.topic: Choose a gym for a joint membership deal

options.name: Downtown Fitness Center
options.upside: Offers a wide range of group classes and long operating hours.
options.concern: Can be crowded during peak evening hours.

options.concern: No subway access and fewer group class options.

shared_context: Three friends are selecting a gym for a joint membership deal. They want facilities that support group workouts, flexible hours, and a location accessible by public transport.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a marketing professional who enjoys structured group workouts to stay motivated.
personas.private_goal: Find a gym with extensive group classes and long hours to fit her busy schedule.

A.reason_for: Wide range of group classes and long operating hours perfectly match Maya's workout style and schedule.

B.reason_for: Affordable and has a swimming pool, but lacks group classes which Maya values highly.
B.reason_against: Fewer group class options and no subway access limit convenience and workout variety.

C.reason_for: 24/7 access and diverse group workouts including yoga offer flexibility and variety.
C.reason_against: Slightly farther from public transport, which may be less convenient.

D.reason_for: Includes sauna and good transit access, adding comfort and convenience.
D.reason_against: Higher monthly fee and shorter hours than preferred reduce appeal.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software engineer who prefers efficient workouts and straightforward gym experiences.
personas.private_goal: Select a gym with flexible hours and good group workout options near public transit.

A.reason_for: Long hours and many group classes fit Liam's need for flexibility and social workouts.

B.reason_for: Lower cost and nearby bus stop are positives.
B.reason_against: Lacks subway access and group classes, which are important to Liam.

C.reason_for: 24/7 access and group classes including yoga provide flexibility and variety.
C.reason_against: Transit access is a bit farther, which is less ideal.

D.reason_for: Good transit options and facilities including sauna.
D.reason_against: Higher fee and shorter hours than preferred reduce attractiveness.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a graphic designer who values comfort and convenient transit access over extensive classes.
personas.private_goal: Choose a gym that balances good public transport access with comfortable amenities.

A.reason_for: Good transit access and many group classes are positive.
A.reason_against: Crowding during peak hours may reduce comfort.

B.reason_for: Affordable and has a swimming pool.
B.reason_against: No subway access and fewer group classes make it less convenient.

C.reason_for: 24/7 access and diverse classes are good, but transit is a bit farther.
C.reason_against: Longer walk to subway station reduces convenience.

D.reason_for: Multiple public transit options nearby and sauna add comfort and ease of access.
